description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartCalculationService, specifically the class ShoppingCartCalculationServiceImpl, which handles recalculating the total price, discounts, and other monetary aspects of the shopping cart. It includes methods for calculating totals with or without a customer context, and interacts with other services like ShoppingCartService and OrderService.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class responsible for calculating the state of shopping cart, including total price and discounts.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates the shopping cart totals with customer context, performing validation and invoking order service.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates the shopping cart totals without customer context, performing validation and invoking order service.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates totals for a shopping cart considering customer, store, and language, updating the cart thereafter.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates totals for a shopping cart considering only store and language, updating the cart thereafter.
